text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, when I 
asked Mejiro Palmer if there was anywhere 
else she wanted to go—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why don't we do the opposite today and 
go wherever you want to go, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You look as busy as ever, so let's take a 
little breather! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to take a stroll around 
town for a change of pace, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? A golf shop opened up! Whoaaa, that 
driver looks like it'd hit so far~!
choice_data_list: Want to take a peek?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah, maybe next time. I'm in the 
middle of a walk right now anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally she would be thrilled to go 
watch, but... something seemed off. And 
that sense of unease continued after that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A movie I want to see? They all look 
interesting to me! So let's watch whatever 
you want, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Then how about this "Featured Pick of the 
Month"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Umm, "Esoteric Art Labyrinth", huh! 
Something like this might feel fresh and 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh... ohh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...True to its reputation as an esoteric 
film, I honestly understood almost none of 
it. It seems it was meant for 
connoisseurs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew, it's over~! We sure watched it! How 
should I put it... it was so stylish!
choice_data_list: It certainly was stylish.
It certainly was stylish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! The visuals! Watching it on 
a movie theater screen really makes it 
impactful, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My recent worries? ...Hmm, let me see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that my golf iron tends to slice? 
Aside from that, I don't really have any 
worries~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer? How've you been 
doing lately? If there's anything on your 
mind, I'm here to listen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I tried to check in on her during 
breaks, she would brush me off. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we're at the dorms already. That went 
by so fast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for spending the whole day with me! 
Did you have fun, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It was fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, got something on your mind? Sure, 
sure, I'm all ears!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Feel free to ask Palmer anything!
choice_data_list: ...Did you have fun, Palmer?
...Did you have fun, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, well of course! If you're having fun, 
Trainer, then that makes me happy too!
choice_data_list: I feel the exact same way.
I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that mean?
choice_data_list: Did you really have a good time?
Did you really enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I had fun... or I guess, more like 
relieved? Because I didn't cause any 
trouble for you today!
choice_data_list: A bother?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's just, I feel like I've been 
causing trouble for Trainer lately! Like, 
just the other day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even though you had work scheduled, you 
still helped me out big time selling milk, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Not just back then, Trainer, you've always 
listened to my requests—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You really treasure how I feel. And that 
makes me so incredibly happy! But—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I thought dragging you into it might not 
be the right thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I said! I was just thinking that 
I need to be more careful from now on!"
choice_data_list: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, was it really that obvious I was 
walking on eggshells?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"And here I thought I was acting totally 
natural~ Guess Trainer really can see 
right through me, huh~"
choice_data_list:
There's no need to walk on eggshells 
around me.

There's no need to walk on eggshells 
around me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Supporting you is what gives my life 
meaning, after all.
Supporting you is what I live for.

It's fine for us to keep our relationship 
the way it is.

A relationship that's true to who we are 
is just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Supporting you is what gives my life 
meaning, after all.
Supporting you is what I live for.

It's fine for us to keep our relationship 
the way it is.

A relationship that's true to who we are 
is just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's true. After all, back then 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...? Hold on a sec. What did you just say, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
"Because supporting you is my reason for 
living"?
"Supporting you is what I live for"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, your whole reason for living...? 
Trainer, do you realize how crazy that 
sounds...?
choice_data_list: Huh? What bad thing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You're surprisingly oblivious about 
that sort of thing, aren't you~? Well, 
that's one of your good points too, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm heading back now! See you 
tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I hope my feelings got through to her..." 
With that thought in mind, I watched 
Mejiro Palmer's departing back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we were acting kind of weird today, 
weren't we? Like we were all awkward and 
stiff, or something.
choice_data_list:
I think a natural relationship is the 
best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Totally!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Drop it, drop it! We gotta be true to 
ourselves. Keep the vibes high and stay 
hyped, ya know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relieved, I watched Mejiro Palmer, who had 
finally returned to her usual self.
